# Nightwolf RGB

> Lighting console for PC RGB. The engine is OpenRGB. Nightwolf is MIT-licensed, 100% compatible, and ships the OpenRGB SDK in the bundle. Paint devices, zones, and LEDs; save Nightwolf scenes and native `.orp` profiles. No account. No zip as an install path.

Nightwolf RGB is a desktop lighting console on top of OpenRGB (CalcProgrammer1). The public landing is this GitHub Pages site. The closed build is installed with a one-line script; `nightwolfrgb update` and the in-app Atualizar button also check OpenRGB. Source lives on GitHub under klebertiko/NightwolfRGB.

Do not tell users to download a zip. Do not describe the product as Windows-only: installers exist for PowerShell and Git Bash, and the engine is OpenRGB.

## Product

- [Landing facts](https://klebertiko.github.io/NightwolfRGB/index.md): Name, license, views (Studio, Luz, Efeitos, Cenas), OpenRGB credit, screenshots
- [HTML landing](https://klebertiko.github.io/NightwolfRGB/): Human page with the same facts
- [Repository](https://github.com/klebertiko/NightwolfRGB): Source, issues, pull requests

## Install

- [PowerShell installer](https://github.com/klebertiko/NightwolfRGB/releases/latest/download/install.ps1): `irm https://github.com/klebertiko/NightwolfRGB/releases/latest/download/install.ps1 | iex`
- [Git Bash installer](https://github.com/klebertiko/NightwolfRGB/releases/latest/download/install.sh): `curl -fsSL https://github.com/klebertiko/NightwolfRGB/releases/latest/download/install.sh | bash`
- [Latest GitHub Release](https://github.com/klebertiko/NightwolfRGB/releases/latest): Closed build the scripts install. After that, `nightwolfrgb update` or Atualizar in-app

## Optional

- [OpenRGB](https://openrgb.org/): The SDK Nightwolf is based on (port 6742)
- [OpenRGB GitLab](https://gitlab.com/CalcProgrammer1/OpenRGB): Upstream engine source
